```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "92%"
)

fit_label <- params$fit_label
generated_at <- params$generated_at
selected_summary <- params$selected_summary
best_params <- params$best_params
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || !length(x)) y else x
}

sections <- Filter(
  function(section) is.list(section) && length(section$figures) > 0L,
  params$sections %||% list()
)

section_slug <- function(name) {
  slug <- tolower(trimws(name %||% "section"))
  slug <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", slug)
  slug <- gsub("(^-+|-+$)", "", slug)
  if (!nzchar(slug)) slug <- "section"
  slug
}

render_figure_block <- function(fig, section_index, figure_index) {
  figure_label <- sprintf("Figure %d.%d %s", section_index, figure_index, fig$title)
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        '<div class="report-figure"><img src="%s" alt="%s" class="report-figure-image"/></div>\n\n',
        fig$html_asset_abs,
        figure_label
      )
    )
  } else {
    pdf_path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", normalizePath(fig$pdf_asset_abs, mustWork = TRUE))
    cat(
      sprintf(
        "![](<%s>){width=92%%}\n\n",
        pdf_path
      )
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf("**%s**\n\n%s\n\n", figure_label, fig$legend))
}

render_section <- function(section, section_index) {
  figs <- section$figures
  if (length(figs) == 0) {
    cat("_No figures found for this section._\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (i in seq_along(figs)) {
    render_figure_block(figs[[i]], section_index, i)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

render_sidebar_nav <- function(sections) {
  cat('<ul class="report-nav-list">\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2 is-active" href="#report-metadata" data-target-id="report-metadata">Report Metadata</a></li>\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2" href="#fit-summary" data-target-id="fit-summary">1. Fit Summary</a></li>\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2" href="#best-parameters" data-target-id="best-parameters">2. Best Parameters</a></li>\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2" href="#figures" data-target-id="figures">3. Figures</a></li>\n')
  if (length(sections) > 0L) {
    for (i in seq_along(sections)) {
      slug <- section_slug(sections[[i]]$name)
      label <- sprintf("3.%d %s", i, sections[[i]]$name)
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h3" href="#%s" data-target-id="%s">%s</a></li>\n',
          slug,
          slug,
          label
        )
      )
    }
  }
  cat('</ul>\n')
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function getTargetId(heading, index) {
    var section = heading.closest('.section');
    if (section && section.id) {
      return section.id;
    }
    var base = heading.id || ('section-' + index);
    heading.id = base;
    return base;
  }

  function setActiveLink(state, activeId) {
    state.links.forEach(function (link) {
      if (link.dataset.targetId === activeId) {
        link.classList.add('is-active');
      } else {
        link.classList.remove('is-active');
      }
    });
  }

  function syncActiveLink(state) {
    if (!state || !state.headings.length) {
      return;
    }

    var threshold = 140;
    var activeHeading = state.headings[0];

    state.headings.forEach(function (heading) {
      if (heading.getBoundingClientRect().top <= threshold) {
        activeHeading = heading;
      }
    });

    setActiveLink(state, getTargetId(activeHeading, 0));
  }

  function bootSidebar() {
    if (window.__reportSidebarBooted) {
      return;
    }
    window.__reportSidebarBooted = true;

    var nav = document.getElementById('report-sidebar-nav');
    var main = document.getElementById('report-main');
    if (!nav || !main) {
      return;
    }

    var state = {
      headings: Array.prototype.slice.call(main.querySelectorAll('h2, h3')),
      links: Array.prototype.slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.report-nav-link'))
    };

    if (!state.headings.length || !state.links.length) {
      return;
    }

    state.links.forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        var target = document.getElementById(link.dataset.targetId);
        if (!target) {
          return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          setActiveLink(state, link.dataset.targetId);
        }, 60);
      });
    });

    var throttled = false;
    function onScroll() {
      if (throttled) {
        return;
      }
      throttled = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        syncActiveLink(state);
        throttled = false;
      });
    }

    syncActiveLink(state);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootSidebar);
  window.addEventListener('load', bootSidebar);
})();
</script>
```

## 3. Figures {#figures}

```{r render-sections, results='asis'}
if (length(sections) == 0L) {
  cat("_No figures found._\n\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_along(sections)) {
    slug <- section_slug(sections[[i]]$name)
    cat(sprintf("### 3.%d %s {#%s}\n\n", i, sections[[i]]$name, slug))
    render_section(sections[[i]], i)
  }
}
```
